The '''''Out Runner''''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]-affiliated [[YL-2200 light freighter]]. Following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the crew of the ''Out Runner'' was dispatched by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] to locate the ''[[Treasure Trove]]'', a [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] that failed to [[Haven (rendezvous point)|rendezvous]] with the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] beyond the [[Galactic Rim/Legends|Galactic Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The ''Out Runner'' located the disabled ''Treasure Trove'' among the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]], its crew dead.
